                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nImportant Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਫਾਊਂਡੇਸ਼ਨ ਫਾਰ ਐਨਵਾਇਰਮੈਂਟਲ ਐਜੂਕੇਸ਼ਨ (FEE):\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 1981 ਵਿੱਚ ਸਥਾਪਿਤ, FEE 77 ਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਦਿਅਕ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮਾਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਟਿਕਾਊ ਵਿਕਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਤਸ਼ਾਹਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਮਰਪਿਤ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਬਲੂ ਫਲੈਗ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਇਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਕਾਰੀ ਪਹਿਲਕਦਮੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਲੂ ਫਲੈਗ ਬੀਚ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਭਾਰਤ 2018 ਵਿੱਚ ਬਲੂ ਫਲੈਗ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਈਕੋ-ਲੇਬਲ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੋਰ ਬੀਚਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਸਰਗਰਮੀ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੀਕਰਨ ਵਾਤਾਵਰਣ, ਵਣ ਅਤੇ ਜਲਵਾਯੂ ਪਰਿਵਰਤਨ ਮੰਤਰਾਲੇ ਦੀ “ਬੀਮਸ” ਪਹਿਲਕਦਮੀ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assertion (A): The President of India can dissolve the Lok Sabha before its term ends.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The President of India, as per the Constitution, has the authority to dissolve the Lok Sabha before the completion of its five-year term. This is in accordance with Article 85 of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Lok Sabha can be dissolved in situations such as the government losing its majority or the Prime Minister advising dissolution to hold fresh elections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The dissolution signifies the end of the current tenure of the Lok Sabha, requiring the formation of a new Lok Sabha through general elections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hence, the assertion is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Reason (R): The President acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The President of India is bound by the advice of the Council of Ministers, headed by the Prime Minister, as per Article 74(1) of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This means that any decision regarding the dissolution of the Lok Sabha has to be made on the advice of the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The President, being the constitutional head of the state, acts based on this advice and does not exercise discretionary power in this regard.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hence, the reason is also correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Explanation of the correct option:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Both the assertion and reason are correct. The President’s ability to dissolve the Lok Sabha is exercised based on the advice provided by the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The reason (R) directly explains why the assertion (A) is valid, as the President cannot act unilaterally in dissolving the Lok Sabha.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Therefore, the correct option is: "Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          નીચે આપેલા વિધાનોને દાવો (A) અને કારણ (R) તરીકે ચિહ્નિત થયેલ વાંચો. સાચો વિકલ્પ પસંદ કરો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಕೆಳಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾದ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದನೆ (A) ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರಣ (R) ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾದ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          கீழே கொடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ள கூற்று (A) மற்றும் காரணம் (R) எனக் குறிக்கப்பட்ட அறிக்கைகளைப் படிக்கவும். சரியான விருப்பத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          கூற்று (A): இந்தியாவின் குடியரசுத் தலைவர் மக்களவையின் பதவிக்காலம் முடிவடைவதற்கு முன்பே அதைக் கலைக்க முடியும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          காரணம் (R): பிரதமர் தலைமையிலான அமைச்சர்கள் குழுவின் ஆலோசனையின்படி குடியரசுத் தலைவர் செயல்படுகிறார்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ନିମ୍ନରେ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ବିବୃତ୍ତିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଦୃଢ଼ୋକ୍ତି (A) ଏବଂ କାରଣ (R) ଭାବରେ ଚିହ୍ନିତ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସଠିକ୍ ବିକଳ୍ପ ଚିହ୍ନିତ କରନ୍ତୁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଦୃଢ଼ୋକ୍ତି (A): ଭାରତର ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରପତି ଲୋକସଭାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକାଳ ଶେଷ ହେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏହାକୁ ଭାଙ୍ଗି ପାରିବେ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          କାରଣ (R): ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରପତି ପ୍ରଧାନମନ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନେତୃତ୍ୱରେ ମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ପରିଷଦର ପରାମର୍ଶ ଅନୁସାରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତି।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਹੇਠਾਂ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਕਥਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦਾਅਵਾ (A) ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ (R) ਵਜੋਂ ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹਿਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਸਹੀ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਚੁਣੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਦਾਅਵਾ (A): ਭਾਰਤ ਦਾ ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰਪਤੀ ਲੋਕ ਸਭਾ ਨੂੰ ਇਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜਕਾਲ ਖਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਭੰਗ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਕਾਰਨ (R): ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰਪਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਦੀ ਅਗਵਾਈ ਵਾਲੀ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਸ਼ਦ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ 'ਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assertion (A): The President of India can dissolve the Lok Sabha before its term ends.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The President of India, as per the Constitution, has the authority to dissolve the Lok Sabha before the completion of its five-year term. This is in accordance with Article 85 of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Lok Sabha can be dissolved in situations such as the government losing its majority or the Prime Minister advising dissolution to hold fresh elections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The dissolution signifies the end of the current tenure of the Lok Sabha, requiring the formation of a new Lok Sabha through general elections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hence, the assertion is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Reason (R): The President acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The President of India is bound by the advice of the Council of Ministers, headed by the Prime Minister, as per Article 74(1) of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This means that any decision regarding the dissolution of the Lok Sabha has to be made on the advice of the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The President, being the constitutional head of the state, acts based on this advice and does not exercise discretionary power in this regard.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hence, the reason is also correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Explanation of the correct option:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Both the assertion and reason are correct. The President’s ability to dissolve the Lok Sabha is exercised based on the advice provided by the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The reason (R) directly explains why the assertion (A) is valid, as the President cannot act unilaterally in dissolving the Lok Sabha.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Therefore, the correct option is: "Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Article 85 of the Indian Constitution:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Article 85 provides the President with the power to summon or prorogue Parliament and dissolve the Lok Sabha.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • However, the President’s exercise of this power is not discretionary and must be based on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Article 74(1) of the Constitution:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • According to Article 74(1), there shall be a Council of Ministers, with the Prime Minister at its head, to aid and advise the President in exercising their functions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The advice given by the Council of Ministers is binding on the President.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Important Points:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The dissolution of the Lok Sabha can occur in two scenarios:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • On the advice of the Prime Minister when the government seeks fresh elections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Automatically at the end of the five-year term of the Lok Sabha.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
